authority: docs/derivations/S10-spec.md section 8.2 with the I-states of section 15 A2-3

inputs_echo.forms: c_p^ig/R = sum_k b_k theta^k; ln(P_sat/Pa) = a + b/theta + c ln theta + d theta^2; theta = T / 1000 K; h^ig(298.15 K) = Delta_fH; Wilson Lambda_ij constant

ladder_settings.converged: no exception from the direct flash call and no solver error from CalculateFlowsheet4, with the stream calculated
ladder_settings.selection: the first rung at which every I-state converges is used for all of them; a state converged at no rung is NOT_COMPARABLE (spec 8.1's rule, B-53)

settings.compounds: user compounds (OriginalDB = CurrentDB = 'User'), CAS 's10-<id>' so that DWSIM's embedded wilson_bips.csv supplies nothing; Molar_Weight = records.yaml molecular_weight in kg/kmol

flash.route: one material stream at the registered (n, T, P), TP-flashed by CalculateFlowsheet4; the property package's flash (UniversalFlash) is also called directly with the same inputs for its raw arrays and iteration count
flash.why: VLE: the Wilson liquid is strictly convex in composition (spec 4.1), so no liquid split exists for the heuristic to look for; FailSafeCalculationMode 3 ('None'): a failed flash raises instead of being replaced by DWSIM's Raoult's-law flash (mode 1, the default); 1000 iterations: T06's value (B-52)

settings.ideal_gas_cp: IdealgasCpEquation '100' (A + B T + C T^2 + D T^3 + E T^4, J/(kmol K)) with coefficient k = 1000 R b_k / 1000^k (spec 8.2: the ideal-gas c_p polynomial)
settings.ideal_gas_formation_enthalpy: IG_Enthalpy_of_Formation_25C = Delta_fH / MW (kJ/kg); DWSIM's stream enthalpies carry no formation term, so the tool adds DWSIM's own AUX_HFm25 to DW_CalcEnthalpy

liquid_density.why: the model's liquid molar volume is zero (spec 3.3, 3.7): DWSIM's Ideal-mode liquid enthalpy adds P / rho_L and its liquid fugacity a Poynting factor; at 1e12 kg/m3 P v <= 1e-8 J/mol and v (P - P_sat) / (R T) <= 1e-13 (B-50, ESC-50)

settings.liquid_heat_capacity: LiquidHeatCapacityEquation '1', constant 1000 R b_0 J/(kmol K): unused by the Ideal enthalpy mode, set only because AUX_HVAPi reads the vaporization equation only when this field is not '0' (docs/reference-environments.md section 6 quirk 4)

placeholders.why: required fields of a DWSIM compound that wilson-ig-v1 does not define; T_c > T / 0.98 keeps every state on the activity-coefficient branch of DW_CalcFugCoeff and AUX_HVAPi below T_c (T06's placeholders)

settings.vaporization_enthalpy: VaporizationEnthalpyEquation '100' (J/kmol) with A = -1000 R b 1000, B = R c 1000, C = 0, D = 2 R d 1e-6 1000, E = 0: Delta h(T) = -1000 R b + R c T + 2 R d T^3 / 1e6 (spec 8.2, eq. 100; the J/kmol unit is fixed by readback)
settings.vapour_pressure: VaporPressureEquation '101' (exp(A + B/T + C ln T + D T^E), Pa) with A = a - c ln 1000, B = 1000 b, C = c, D = d 1e-6, E = 2 (spec 8.2)

wilson.rule: per state (spec 8.2): A_ij = -1.9872 T ln(Lambda_ij V_i / V_j) cal/mol with V from DWSIM's GetArguments, stored as BIPs[cas_i][cas_j] = (A_ij, A_ji) for i < j (WilsonModel.GetBIPs returns A_ij for (i, j) and A_ji for (j, i))
